name: Youth Member, Parks, Recreation and Open Space Commission
what_you_do: Sit on the city commission that gives advice on parks, open space, recreation and youth. You share a teen view with the City Council and help shape park and recreation plans.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 21 when you are appointed. You must live in Concord or go to school in Concord. You must be able to serve for one year, September 1 to June 30. Part-time seasonal city workers can apply.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, June 12, 2026 at 5 PM. The city says it holds a formal recruitment in odd-numbered years, or when a seat opens. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Commission Application from the city website. Email it to the City Clerk. The adult commissioners pick the youth members.
notes: The commission has five adult members and two youth members. The youth term is one year. The Clerk email is cityclerk@cityofconcord.org. The commission meets at 6 PM as needed at 1950 Parkside Drive, Concord.
